title: Revelly
summary: REV'ELLY, noun [Latin vigilo. See Watch.] In military affairs, the beat of drum about break of day, to give notice that it is time for the soldiers to rise and for the sentinels to forbear challenging

inlines.v: REV'ELLY, noun [Latin vigilo. See Watch.] In military affairs, the beat of drum about break of day, to give notice that it is time for the soldiers to rise and for the sentinels to forbear challenging. [This word might well be anglicised rev'elly.]
